Filing gate: a protocol defect in the PM tooling (two rules give two answers to one card), filed under SKILL.md's 「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡」. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim. Filed by `domain:engine` seat 1 (seat post #6367) · `session_01EUBvqtauTDmHi2ZgY759p2`, from its claim on #22135 (6051656254).

## The two texts (read at `origin/main` `ec8f37c890`)

- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (the `--tier` note, the string beginning "Clause ② is NOT reachable from paths"): "a card that changes contract accept/reject behaviour or widens the public surface owes a contract-review-tier REVIEW too (owed in the spec and skills lanes …; a hit outside those lanes is spec-lane work and moves there)".
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md`, 〈认领〉 and 〈派发〉: 「`Clause-②: yes | no` … 判据:本卡放宽接受集或扩大公开面吗」 and 「强制条款②:放宽接受集或扩大公开面的卡默认判断档施工;命中即 spec 车道的活」.

## Where they diverge

A card that only NARROWS an accept set (refuses something accepted today) is "changes accept/reject behaviour" under the first text, so it owes a contract review and is spec-lane work; under the second it is `Clause-②: no`, owes no review, and stays in its lane.

## The case that surfaced it

#22135 (p1, the maintainer's Q4 = A on #15196: refuse a package install whose security-catalog name another holder has). Triage graded it `domain:engine` with `Clause-②: yes`; the claiming seat wrote `Clause-②: no` (a refusal widens nothing) and, as the stricter reading, commissions an at-tier contract review before the queue without moving the card to the spec lane. Either reading of the card is defensible from one of the two texts, which is the defect.

## For the skills seat

Which text is the rule, and whether the other is reworded to match. No change is proposed here.

None is this.
